routingNotes.C-D: CHUM January 2026 guide states public circulation between Pavilions C and D is available at the 1st, 2nd and 8th floors.
routingNotes.D-R: CHUM January 2026 guide states the underground passage at basement level 1 between Pavilions D and R is accessible to all and provides access to Champ-de-Mars métro.
routingNotes.C-F: Not included in public graph: the 5th-floor walkway is staff-only and the basement-2 passage is staff/physician/logistics only.
routingNotes.E-F: Not included in public graph: the underground passage is staff/physician and escorted-patient only.
